label: Post-result Version 3 correction and retrospective matched Version 2 comparison
authorized_by: User request in this chat, 11 October 2026; no independent mentor approval inferred

oulad.rule_rationale: Separate zero, one and multiple prior attempts. Pool 12 twos and one three into a historical tail; keep unseen higher integer counts in that tail. No tuning against later records or outcomes. Sparse tail limits interpretation.
oulad.unchanged: Source records, split, cohort, groups, support, studied_credits bins, model coefficients, outcome thresholds; natural scores remain descriptive
oulad.baseline: Constant training-majority class; tie predicts 0; never select from audit labels

v2.selection: All originally declared synthetic cases and repeats from saved cases.json; no Adult extension
v2.scope: All nine declared group views and all declared features; fixed Holm family at each look
v2.look_budget: alpha / 20; not a combined PSI-or-KS monitor
v2.comparison: Single shared scheduler and same complete observation blocks, no truncation or extra observations. Original PSI scores, eligibility, starts and hit sets must replay. Censored non-significant Monte Carlo p-values may differ because the matched engine stops at the horizon cutoff.
v2.cost: Same-block test costs and logical payload recorded; process peak RSS is shared; neither is a deployment memory claim

freeze: Freeze verified numerical set, code/config/source hashes and claims. Final choice among project versions remains the user’s decision; no final submission drafted.
